feat(camellia): migrate initial woodii batch pages

Summary:
- add dedicated Camellia routes and page implementations for the
  first Woodii migration batch: logoff, anomalous, version,
  feedback, agreement, tutorial, issue, and explanation
- extend the shared Woodii API client with the deactivation,
  universal-content, version, and feedback endpoints used by these
  pages
- add the navigation and i18n coverage needed for the new scoped
  admin surfaces

Rationale:
- DAM-63 starts with the highest-ROI CRUD and content pages, so the
  new admin shell needs real page surfaces instead of module
  placeholders for these menu nodes
- keeping the request logic in the shared client and the route/page
  behavior in Camellia matches the project migration constraints and
  preserves the existing shell architecture

Tests:
- pnpm --dir labelix/bougainvillea run typecheck:camellia
- pnpm --dir labelix/bougainvillea --filter @bougainvillea/camellia build
